latest.title: Möbius Invariant Dimers and Miquel Dynamics
latest.abstract: As is already known, there is a correspondence between circle patterns and the dimer model, which is invariant under Euclidean transformations. We establish a new correspondence that is invariant under the group of Möbius transformations PO(3,1), which is the natural symmetry group of circle patterns. We show that Miquel dynamics preserve the partition function, and that convexity of the t-embedding guarantees positivity of the face weights. We also show that the correspondence has a somewhat hidden symmetry group PO(3,3), which relates to the Lorentz lift of the t-embedding. Finally, we consider isoradial graphs, Doyle spirals, the once-punctured torus and isothermic circle patterns.
latest.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
latest.workSummary: 建立 Möbius 不变的圆模式–dimer 对应，证明 Miquel 动力保持配分函数。
latest.breakthrough: 揭示 PO(3,3) 隐对称及权重正性条件。
latest.limitations: 正性依赖凸性，不能对任意嵌入无条件应用。 研究结论按摘要级分析；未完成正文方法核验。
latest.priorityReason: 离散可积几何与统计物理交叉。
